landing.about_hardwar: Hardwar, an exciting challenge and a chance to learn and grow
landing.competition: The main part of the HardWar competition presents participants with challenges in areas such as Embedded Systems, Cybersecurity, Reverse Engineering, Machine Learning, and more. Aimed at enhancing technical skills and problem-solving abilities, the competition offers a unique opportunity for enthusiasts and professionals alike.
landing.intro: Hardwar is an annual tech competition by Sharif University, bridging academia and industry through real-world challenges in IoT, embedded systems, and automation. It’s a hub for innovation, talent discovery, and collaboration.
landing.location: Sharif University of Technology - Tehran, Iran
landing.organizers: Brought to life through the collaboration of academic communities and industry partners
landing.prize: With the support of the event's sponsoring companies, valuable prizes will be awarded to the top teams in the Hardwar competition. These prizes are intended to recognize the participants' efforts, creativity, and technical skills. The financial and moral support of the sponsors plays a significant role in enhancing the quality of this competition.
landing.resume: Participants can upload their resumes on the event's website. After an initial review and with the participants' consent, the resumes will be forwarded to the event's sponsoring companies, and subsequent steps such as interview invitations and recruitment processes will be carried out by the companies.
landing.staff: A passionate team of students and researchers, driving Hardwar from concept to execution
landing.workshop: As part of the preparation for participants of the HardWar event, a series of practical and specialized workshops will be held. These workshops are designed to enhance technical knowledge, cover key topics, and improve essential hands-on skills. It is a great opportunity for deeper learning and effective competition readiness.
